synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — a self-funding, guidance-meeting, near-floor-multiple business against a goodwill-impaired, 4.1x-levered, hard-de-rating consensus with an earned peer discount.

bull_points.claim: The EV/EBITDA has fallen to 3.9x (near its own 5.5-year floor) even as absolute EBITDA has stayed near record levels — the falling multiple is an optical de-rate against a business whose LTM EBITDA is $1,275M, above every prior year except FY24's $1,295M.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Multiples 'TEV/LTM EBITDA' Close (latest) — current multiple

bull_points.claim: The margin %-versus-absolute reconciler shows EBITDA margin flat at ~13% while absolute EBITDA rose FY17 246 → LTM 1,275 and revenue rose 1,990 → 9,999 — the margin optic masks a business several times larger in absolute cash terms.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: The company is free-cash-flow positive at $775.6M LTM and buying back stock (share count -5.9% over ~1.7y), consistent with a self-funding, not distressed, capital posture.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [LTM 12 months May-31-2026]

bull_points.claim: Management's mix-shift mechanism is showing leading traction: signed annual contract value for AI-inclusive solutions more than doubled QoQ, the causal 'why' behind a claimed accretive-after-scale revenue mix.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: Concentrix Corporation, Q1 2026 Earnings Call, Mar 24, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: Bookings momentum is corroborated by a 9% YoY rise in new wins and a 14% rise in transformational deal values exiting 2025 — forward demand indicators, not just trailing revenue.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: Concentrix Corporation, Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Jan 13, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: The guidance track record is intact — revenue actual ≥ guided floor 22/26 resolved quarters, EPS 12/13, and the most recent FQ2 2026 print MET — arguing the de-rate is not a delivery-failure story.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Guidance (latest guide + sign-aware delivery track-record)

bull_points.claim: S&P issuer rating is BBB- (investment grade) with credit-health scores 4/4/4/4 recorded, and interest coverage is 4.6x — a solvency profile inconsistent with a terminal read at face value.

bear_points.claim: GAAP net income swung to -$1,314M LTM driven by a -$1,523M goodwill impairment — a write-down of prior acquisition value that is the load-bearing signal the market is pricing, not an optical artifact.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Cash Flow (annual) + Estimates→Trends (FY E)

bear_points.claim: Leverage is genuinely elevated and is the real signal, not an optic: net-debt/EBITDA 4.1x vs peer-median total-debt/EBITDA 2.0x, with $5,249M net debt against a $1,550M market cap — the equity is a thin sliver atop a large debt stack.

bear_points.claim: The peer discount is at least partly EARNED: EBITDA margin 13% vs peer-median 18%, revenue growth 4% vs 6%, and Debt/EBITDA 3.2 vs 2.0 — worse on margin, growth and leverage simultaneously, the classic value-trap fingerprint.

bear_points.claim: Consensus is cutting hard, not stabilizing: FY26 GAAP EPS revised -43% (5.60→3.19) and FY26 EBT (GAAP) -52% (12m→latest), with the crux LT-growth assumption slashed 6.3%→4.27% — forward-estimate deterioration, not a trailing snapshot.

Every gap-down clusters on debt/financing and earnings filings (two Feb debt-offering 8-Ks, a March securitization-facility amendment, a June earnings print) — the drawdown is anchored to balance-sheet and results events, not noise.

decisive_question.question: Is the accretive-mix shift toward AI/complex work real enough to re-accelerate revenue and margin fast enough to de-lever the $5.2B debt stack before it becomes the dominant fact — or is the goodwill impairment plus earned peer-discount telling the truer story of structural erosion?

evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ transcript: Concentrix Corporation, Q1 2026 Earnings Call, Mar 24, 2026.rtf

evidence_for.claim: Guidance has been met on the most recent print and delivered against floor in a large majority of resolved quarters, supporting management's execution credibility.

evidence_against.claim: The two highest-mix verticals (tech/consumer-electronics and healthcare) each fell ~6% in constant currency, showing the shift is not yet lifting the verticals it must.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ transcript: Concentrix Corporation, Q1 2026 Earnings Call, Mar 24, 2026.rtf

evidence_against.claim: FY26 GAAP EPS consensus was cut -43% and LT-growth slashed to 4.27%, i.e. the analyst base is de-rating the very re-acceleration the bull case needs.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (current-FY consensus path; ragged, absent lookbacks n/a)

evidence_against.claim: Net-debt/EBITDA of 4.1x against a $1.55B equity cushion leaves little margin for a slow de-lever if revenue does not re-accelerate.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Net Debt $5,249M [Q2 May-31-2026] ÷ CIQ EBITDA $1,275M [LTM 12 months May-31-2026]

key_unknowns: No forward/adjusted EV/EBITDA basis is supplied (ev_ebitda_adjusted_fwd UNKNOWN and adjusted_eps UNKNOWN not in the 99.1 guidance) — the trailing 3.9x alone cannot distinguish cheap-overshoot from cheap-terminal.
Covenant basis and net-debt/company-adjusted-EBITDA are UNKNOWN (not disclosed) — the true covenant headroom on a $5.2B debt stack is an unresolved BEARISH-leaning gap, not a neutral one.

Single-segment (Software & Programming) reporting means NO segment-EBITDA breakout — cannot isolate which verticals or the AI/iX Suite line actually earn vs burn; a missing expected disclosure that skews bearish.
Self-funding is MIXED: latest-quarter OCF is negative while LTM FCF is positive — seasonality per management is claimed but the intra-year cash bridge is unresolved.
Management targets net leverage below 2.6x by end-FY26, but the path from 4.1x rests on unverified asset-sale proceeds and second-half profitability ramp not yet in results.

The heterogeneous peer set (caps $119M–$28.9B, 243x span) means every peer multiple is a confidence-gated input; whether the discount to a $1.6B name is truly EARNED vs RESIDUAL is unresolved and must be judged, not read off the median.
Export/as-of dating is a FLOOR (≥2026-07-06, unverified) — the currency of the consensus path and multiples ladder cannot be pinned.

caveats: P/E may be distorted by non-recurring EPS — latest annual EPS -20.36 vs recent median 4.71; verify against normalized/forward EPS (CIQ)

EDGAR P/E 6.0x does not rest on LTM GAAP earnings — LTM GAAP diluted EPS is NEGATIVE (-21.35), so a positive multiple must use some other denominator (an EPS from a non-current period, or a normalized/adjusted figure — the displayed basis does not say which). Do not read it as a GAAP trailing multiple.

Net debt/EBITDA (4.1x) is on REPORTED EBITDA (CIQ / consolidated GAAP), not the covenant basis; management and credit covenants typically define leverage on adjusted EBITDA (a larger denominator → a lower ratio), reconciled in the earnings release/transcript (currently UNAVAILABLE) — do not read 4.1x as the covenant-basis leverage.

business_description.value: Concentrix Corporation designs, builds, and runs integrated customer experience (CX) solutions worldwide. It provides CX process optimization, technology innovation and design engineering, front- and back-office automation, analytics, and business transformation services to clients in various industry verticals comprising technology and consumer electronics; retail, travel, and e-commerce; communications and media; banking, financial services, and insurance; and healthcare. The company also offers customer lifecycle management; CX and user experience strategy and design; data analytics, enterprise intelligence, artificial intelligence readiness, and actionable insights; digital operations, such as B2B sales, performance marketing, customer loyalty, trust and safety, collections, and financial compliance; and GenAI and agentic AI technologies. In addition, it provides digital transformation services that designs and engineer CX solutions to enable efficient customer self-service and build customer loyalty; customer engagement solutions and services that address the entirety of the customer lifecycle; and AI technology that can intelligently act on customer intent to improve customer experience with non-human engagement. Further, the company offers self-service GenAI and agentic AI assistants for applications in data analysis, language translations, and internal chatbots; voice of the customer and analytics solutions to gather and analyze customer feedback; analytics and consulting solutions that synthesize data and provide professional insight to improve clients’ customer experience strategies; specialized support to specific industry verticals; and back office services that support clients in non-customer facing areas. It serves technology and consumer electronics, retail, travel and e-commerce, communications and media, banking, financial services and insurance, healthcare, and other industries. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Newark, California.
